## Base URL

| Variable | Purpose |

arguments.content:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 1200, 1600

CREAM = (247, 243, 234)
INK = (28, 32, 38)
BRASS = (176, 132, 58)
RUST = (150, 62, 40)
MUTE = (96, 90, 80)

def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

sansb = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
sans = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
serifb = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf"
serif = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf"

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), CREAM)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

m = 44
d.rectangle([m, m, W - m, H - m], outline=INK, width=6)
d.rectangle([m + 15, m + 15, W - m - 15, H - m - 15], outline=BRASS, width=3)

def center(text, y, fnt, fill):
    box = d.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    tw = box[2] - box[0]
    d.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return y + (box[3] - box[1])

center("CROSSROADS CONSERVATORY OF MUSIC", 118, font(sansb, 30), MUTE)
d.line([(W / 2 - 250, 176), (W / 2 + 250, 176)], fill=BRASS, width=3)

center("STUDIO B EAST", 240, font(sansb, 96), INK)
center("TEEN JAZZ ENSEMBLE", 372, font(serifb, 58), RUST)
center("Thursday clinic  \u00b7  ensemble setup", 452, font(serif, 34), MUTE)

panel_top, panel_bottom = 560, 1140
d.rectangle([m + 55, panel_top, W - m - 55, panel_bottom], fill=INK)
center("MUSIC STAND COUNT", panel_top + 40, font(sansb, 40), CREAM)
d.line([(W / 2 - 300, panel_top + 108), (W / 2 + 300, panel_top + 108)], fill=BRASS, width=2)

rows = [
    ("STANDS NEEDED", "12"),
    ("ON HAND", "8"),
    ("TO ADD", "4"),
]
ry = panel_top + 150
label_font = font(sans, 46)
value_font = font(sansb, 92)
for label, value in rows:
    d.text((m + 110, ry), label, font=label_font, fill=CREAM)
    vbox = d.textbbox((0, 0), value, font=value_font)
    vw = vbox[2] - vbox[0]
    color = BRASS if label == "TO ADD" else CREAM
    d.text((W - m - 110 - vw, ry - 28), value, font=value_font, fill=color)
    ry += 132

center("one stand per player  \u00b7  guest brings his own", 1180, font(serif, 30), MUTE)

d.line([(W / 2 - 300, 1420), (W / 2 + 300, 1420)], fill=BRASS, width=2)
center("Crossroads Conservatory  \u00b7  Kansas City, Missouri", 1448, font(sans, 26), MUTE)

out = "/root/workspace/placard.png"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
img.save(out, "PNG")
print("saved", out, img.size)
